summary.topic: A speaker portfolio mapped onto a globe
summary.learning_goal: Communicate career and talk locations; transferable to geographic storytelling rather than a lesson in the talk subjects.
summary.primary_visualization: Editorial portrait section followed by a globe with venue miniatures and adjacent talk descriptions.
summary.primary_interaction: Demo scrolls between sections and changes active location/talk while the globe reorients.

strengths: Talk title and city labels align within a consistent information panel.
weaknesses: Talk dates and career claims are not independently verified.

strengths: A location-linked story can help connect events to a geographic context.
weaknesses: The portfolio names technical talks but does not teach their content.

strengths: Globe orientation and small venue scenes connect the event to a place.
weaknesses: A stage miniature on a globe is an illustrative metaphor, not a geographically scaled depiction.

strengths: Selected locations and descriptions change across Durham, Barcelona, Amsterdam and Taipei.
weaknesses: Scroll/click triggers cannot all be separated from edits in the recording; no live response tested.

strengths: Editorial typography, generous spacing and coherent section transitions provide strong visual hierarchy.
weaknesses: Some event-filter text is very small; mobile and keyboard navigation are unverified.

top_strengths: A location-linked story can help connect events to a geographic context.

top_weaknesses: Talk dates and career claims are not independently verified.

principles_to_learn: Keep location and narrative synchronized in linked views.
Transition from identity to context to detailed events with consistent typography.
Use progressive disclosure to keep extensive event data secondary to the active story.
things_not_to_copy: Do not confuse listing educational talks with teaching their subjects.
Do not copy a decorative avatar into every educational notebook.
golden_recommendation: Provisional demo reference. Use for scrollytelling, linked globe and text, progressive disclosure. Live behavior remains unverified.
